Middle 35 percent: picturesque industrial coastal district, layered terracotta and cream warehouses, copper-green roofs, tall slim loading cranes, a large arched stone viaduct, tiny far away boats; compress detail into confident silhouettes, strong diagonal rhythms. Lower 40 percent: spacious deep desaturated petrol-blue water, sparse broad muted gold reflections and gentle horizontal brush streaks; foreground corners dark harbor pilings and hanging ropes, but leave center clear so a 3D foreground arena can overlay it. Art direction: deliberately illustrated anime cel scene painting, dark navy contours, two hard shadow levels, matte gouache color blocks, ivory/terracotta/aged brass/teal palette, high craft and evocative place. Much more designed and simplified than photorealistic concept art. Avoid sparkles, lens flares, metallic PBR shine, neon, cluttered mini-details, copy of any existing game. The camera looks down slightly from an elevated diagonal tactical view; far skyline stays in upper third and foreground water dominates below. No vignette blur. Background asset must feel like a beautiful constructed game location, not generic low-poly boxes.
